dish_archetypes.description: Ripe plantain fried until caramelised, as a side or snack, across West Africa, the Caribbean, Latin America and South India.
Rice simmered with beans or peas as an everyday staple: rice and beans, rice and peas, moros, waakye.
Chicken marinated in a pungent spice paste and roasted or grilled until charred.

dish_archetypes.canonical_label: Rice cooked in tomato and pepper
dish_archetypes.description: Rice steamed in a reduced tomato-pepper base: jollof and its relatives.
Greens cooked down with aromatics, oil and often protein: efo riro, callaloo, palak, sukuma wiki.
Lentils, beans or chickpeas simmered with aromatics: dal, misir wot, red red, curry chana.

dish_archetypes.canonical_label: Eggs in a spiced tomato sauce
dish_archetypes.description: Eggs cooked in or with a peppery tomato base: shakshuka, huevos rancheros, yam and egg sauce.

dish_archetypes.canonical_label: Bean fritters and steamed bean cakes
dish_archetypes.description: Ground beans whipped and fried or steamed: akara, moi moi.
Cornmeal cooked thick or soft: ugali, pap, cornmeal porridge, arepas.

dish_archetypes.canonical_label: Chicken braised in a rich sauce
dish_archetypes.description: Chicken simmered in a spiced sauce: curry chicken, yassa, karahi, adobo, machboos.

recipes.title: Party Jollof Rice with Roast Chicken

recipe.name: Party Jollof Rice with Roast Chicken
steps: Season {chicken} with {curry*0.5}, {thyme*0.5} and salt. Roast at 220 °C until golden and cooked through [t35].
Blend {tomato}, {redpepper}, {scotch} and {onion*0.5} until smooth.
Slice the remaining {onion*0.5}. Heat {oil} in a heavy pot, fry the onion 3 minutes, then add {tomatopaste} and fry until it darkens to brick red [t5].
Pour in the blend with the rest of the curry and thyme and {bay}. Cook uncovered, stirring often, until reduced by half and the oil rises to the top [t20].
Rinse {rice} until the water runs clear. Stir it into the base with {stock}. Cover with foil and a lid and cook on the lowest heat [t30]. Shake the pot instead of stirring.
Done when the grains are tender but separate. Let a light crust form at the bottom for smoky party flavour, then serve with the chicken.

recipe.name: Efo Riro with Boiled Yam
steps: Cut {beef} into chunks, season with salt and half the onion, and simmer in {stock} until tender [t30]. Keep the broth.
Peel {yam}, cut into thick rounds and boil in salted water until a knife slides in easily [t20].
Blend {redpepper} and {scotch} coarsely. Wash and roughly chop {spinach}, then squeeze out the water.
Warm {palmoil} gently (don't let it smoke). Fry the remaining {onion*0.5}, add the pepper blend and fry until thick [t10].
Add the beef, a splash of broth and {crayfish}. Fold in the spinach and cook just until wilted and bright green [t3]. Serve with the yam.

recipe.name: Moi Moi (Steamed Bean Pudding)
steps: Soak {blackeyed} for 15 minutes, then rub between your palms to slip off the skins; rinse until mostly skinless [t15].
Hard-boil {eggs} [t10], cool and halve.
Blend the beans with {redpepper}, {onion} and {stock} into a smooth, thick batter.
Stir in {oil}, {crayfish} and salt. Divide into greased ramekins or foil packets and tuck half an egg into each.
Steam over simmering water, topping up as needed [t45]. Set when a knife comes out clean.

recipe.name: Akara with Agege Bread
steps: Soak {blackeyed} 15 minutes and rub off the skins [t15].
Blend with {onion} and {scotch} using as little water as possible. Whisk the batter for 3 minutes until fluffy — this is what makes akara light.
Heat {oil} to 175 °C. Drop in spoonfuls of batter and fry, turning, until deep golden [t6].
Drain on paper and serve hot, tucked into {bread}.

recipe.name: Yam & Egg Sauce
steps: Peel and cube {yam}; boil in salted water until fork-tender [t15].
Meanwhile dice {tomato}, {onion} and {scotch}. Fry the onion in {oil} for 2 minutes, add tomato and scotch and cook down [t6].
Pour in beaten {eggs} and stir gently until fully set, with no runny parts. Serve over the yam.

recipe.name: Chicken Pepper Soup
steps: Cut {chicken} into pieces. Put in a pot with chopped {onion}, {peppersoup}, salt and {stock}.
Bring to a boil, then simmer [t25].
Add cubed {potato} and pounded {scotch}; simmer until the potatoes are tender and the chicken is cooked through [t15].
Tear in {basil} (stands in for scent leaf) and serve steaming.

recipe.name: Egusi Soup with Eba
steps: Simmer {beef} in {stock} with half the onion and salt until tender [t30].
Blend the remaining {onion*0.5} and mix with {egusi} and a little water into a thick paste.
Warm {palmoil}, add the egusi paste in spoonfuls and fry undisturbed for 5 minutes, then stir and fry until curdled and nutty [t10].
Add the beef and broth, {scotch} and {crayfish}. Simmer [t10]. Fold in chopped {spinach} and cook 3 minutes.
Eba: pour {garri} into about 2½ times its volume of just-boiled water, rest 2 minutes, then stir hard into a smooth, firm dough.

recipe.name: Red Red with Fried Plantain
steps: Simmer {blackeyed} in plenty of water until soft but holding shape [t40]. Drain.
Fry chopped {onion} in {palmoil}, add grated {ginger}, chopped {tomato} and {scotch}; cook to a thick sauce [t10].
Stir in the beans and simmer 5 minutes until everything turns red red.
Slice ripe {plantain} on the diagonal and fry in {oil} until caramelised on both sides [t6].

recipe.name: Poulet Yassa
steps: Marinate {chicken} with the juice of {lemon}, {mustard}, minced {garlic}, half the oil and sliced {onion} for at least 30 minutes [t30].
Lift out the chicken and sear in the remaining {oil*0.5} until browned. Set aside.
Cook the onions from the marinade slowly until soft and golden [t20], then return the chicken with the marinade and a whole {scotch}.
Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through [t25]. Meanwhile cook {rice}.

recipe.name: Poulet DG
steps: Season {chicken} with {garlic}, {ginger} and salt; brown in half the {oil} [t10].
Fry sliced ripe {plantain} in the rest of the oil until golden; set aside.
Add {onion}, {tomato}, sliced {carrot}, {greenbeans} and {redpepper} to the chicken with 200 ml water; simmer until the chicken is cooked through [t20].
Fold in the plantains and warm through.

recipe.name: Misir Wot with Injera
steps: Cook finely chopped {onion} in a dry pot, stirring, until soft and jammy [t10], then add {oil}.
Add {berbere}, {garlic}, {ginger} and {tomatopaste}; cook 3 minutes.
Add {lentils} and 1 L water; simmer, stirring, until thick and soft [t25].
Serve with injera, or {flatbread} if injera isn't available.

recipe.name: Sukuma Wiki & Ugali with Beef
steps: Brown {beefmince} in {oil} until no pink remains [t6].
Add {onion} and {tomato}; cook down [t5]. Add finely sliced {kale} and cook just until tender [t5].
Ugali: bring 1.2 L water to a boil, gradually add {cornmeal} and stir hard with a wooden spoon until thick and pulling from the sides [t10].

recipe.name: Chakalaka & Pap with Boerewors
steps: Grill or pan-fry {sausage} until browned and cooked through [t15].
Chakalaka: fry {onion}, {redpepper}, {garlic}, {scotch} and {curry} in {oil}; add grated {carrot} [t8], then {bakedbeans}; simmer 5 minutes.
Pap: whisk {cornmeal} into 1.2 L boiling water, cover and cook on low, stirring now and then [t20].

recipe.name: Ackee & Saltfish with Fried Plantain
steps: Soak {saltfish} overnight, or boil it in fresh water twice for 10 minutes each to remove the salt [t20]. Flake, discarding bones.
Fry sliced {onion}, {redpepper} and {scotch} in half the {oil} with {thyme} until soft [t5].
Add the saltfish and chopped {tomato}; cook 3 minutes.
Drain {ackee} and fold in very gently so it stays in pieces. Heat through [t3].
Fry sliced {plantain} in the remaining oil until golden.

recipe.name: Curry Chicken with Rice
steps: Rub {chicken} with half the {curry}, minced {garlic}, {thyme}, {allspice} and salt. Rest 20 minutes, or overnight [t20].
Toast the remaining curry in hot {oil} for 1 minute until fragrant, then brown the chicken.
Add sliced {onion}, a whole {scotch} and 500 ml water. Cover and simmer [t30].
Add cubed {potato} and simmer uncovered until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through [t15]. Serve with {rice}.

recipe.name: Jerk Chicken with Rice & Peas
steps: Rub {chicken} with {jerkpaste}; marinate at least 30 minutes (overnight is best) [t30].
Roast at 220 °C until charred at the edges and cooked through [t35].
Rice and peas: bring {coconutmilk}, the liquid from {kidneybeans} topped up with water to 1 L, {thyme}, {allspice}, crushed {scallion} and a whole {scotch} to a simmer.
Add rinsed {rice} and the beans, cover and cook on low until fluffy [t25]. Remove the scotch bonnet before serving.

recipe.name: Cornmeal Porridge
steps: Whisk {cornmeal} into 500 ml cold water until no lumps remain.
Bring {milk} and {coconutmilk} to a simmer, then whisk in the cornmeal mixture.
Cook on low, stirring often, until thick and smooth [t12].
Sweeten with {sugar} and finish with {nutmeg} and {cinnamon}.

recipe.name: Steamed Callaloo with Fried Dumplings
steps: Mix {flour} with a pinch of salt and about 150 ml water into a firm dough. Shape into small flat rounds.
Fry the dumplings in {oil} over medium heat until golden and hollow-sounding [t10].
Strip and slice {kale} (stands in for callaloo). Melt {butter}, soften {onion}, {garlic} and {scotch}, then add {tomato}.
Add the greens with a splash of water, cover and steam until tender [t8].

recipe.name: Curry Chana & Aloo with Roti
steps: Mix {curry} and {cumin} with a little water into a paste. Fry in {oil} until it darkens [t2].
Add chopped {onion} and {garlic}, then cubed {potato}, drained {chickpeas}, {scotch} and 500 ml water.
Simmer until the potatoes break down and thicken the sauce [t20]. Mash a few chickpeas against the pot.
Stir in {cilantro} (stands in for shado beni) and serve with warm {flatbread}.

recipe.name: Griot with Pikliz
steps: Pikliz: shred {cabbage} and {carrot}, slice {scotch*0.5}, pack into a jar and cover with {vinegar} and a pinch of salt. Chill.
Cube {pork} and marinate with the juice of {orange} and {lime}, {garlic}, {onion}, {thyme} and the remaining scotch [t30].
Simmer the pork in its marinade plus water to cover until tender [t50]. Drain.
Fry the pork in {oil} until crisp at the edges [t10]. Serve with {rice} and pikliz.

recipe.name: Mangú with Eggs & Pickled Onions
steps: Slice {redonion} thinly and soak in {vinegar} with a pinch of salt.
Peel {greenplantain}, cut into chunks and boil until very soft [t20].
Mash with {butter} and a splash of the cooking water until smooth.
Fry {eggs} in {oil} until the whites are fully set. Top the mangú with eggs and pickled onions.

recipe.name: Moros y Cristianos
steps: Sofrito: cook chopped {onion}, {redpepper} and {garlic} in {oliveoil} until soft [t8].
Add {cumin}, {oregano} and {bay}, then {rice}; stir 1 minute to toast.
Add {blackbeans} with their liquid and {stock}. Cover and simmer on low [t20].
Rest 5 minutes off the heat, then fluff.

recipe.name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Char {tomato}, {onion} and {jalapeno} in a dry pan [t6], then blend into a salsa and simmer 5 minutes.
Warm {blackbeans} and mash lightly.
Warm {tortilla} in a dry pan. Fry {eggs} in {oil} until the whites are set.
Layer tortillas, beans, egg and salsa. Top with sliced {avocado}, crumbled {cheese} and {cilantro}.

recipe.name: Chicken Tinga Tacos
steps: Poach {chicken} in salted water until cooked through [t20]. Shred.
Blend {tomato}, {chipotle} and {garlic}. Soften sliced {onion} in {oil}, add the sauce and simmer [t8].
Fold in the chicken and simmer until saucy.
Serve in warm {tortilla} with shredded {cabbage}, {avocado} and wedges of {lime}.

recipe.name: Lomo Saltado
steps: Cook {rice}. Cut {potato} into fries and oven-bake at 220 °C until crisp [t30].
Slice {sirloin} into strips. Sear in very hot {oil*0.3} in batches until browned [t3]. Remove.
Stir-fry wedges of {redonion} and {jalapeno} for 1 minute, add {tomato} wedges, {soysauce} and {vinegar}.
Return the beef, toss with the fries and {cilantro}. Serve with rice.

recipe.name: Moqueca Baiana
steps: Marinate {whitefish} with the juice of {lime}, {garlic} and salt [t15].
Layer sliced {onion}, {redpepper} and {tomato} in a wide pot and lay the fish on top.
Pour over {coconutmilk} and {palmoil}. Cover and simmer gently until the fish flakes [t15].
Scatter with {cilantro}. Serve with {rice}.

recipe.name: Arepas with Huevos Pericos
steps: Mix {masarepa} with 400 ml warm water and salt into a soft dough. Rest [t5].
Shape 8 patties and cook in a dry pan until crusty on both sides [t12].
Melt {butter}, cook chopped {scallion} and {tomato} for 3 minutes.
Add beaten {eggs} and scramble until fully set. Split the arepas and fill with eggs and {cheese}.

recipe.name: Chickpea & Vegetable Tagine with Couscous
steps: Soften chopped {onion} and {garlic} in {oliveoil} [t5]. Add {rasel} and cook 1 minute.
Add chunks of {carrot} and {sweetpotato}, {passata} and 400 ml water. Simmer [t15].
Add {zucchini}, drained {chickpeas} and {apricot}. Simmer until all the vegetables are tender [t15].
Pour 1¼ times its volume of boiling water over {couscous}, cover 5 minutes, then fluff. Serve with {cilantro}.

recipe.name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften sliced {onion} and {redpepper} in {oliveoil} [t8]. Add {garlic}, {cumin} and {paprika}.
Pour in {passata} and simmer until thick [t10].
Make 8 wells and crack in {eggs}. Cover and cook until the whites are fully set [t7].
Scatter with {parsley} and serve with {bread}.

recipe.name: Koshari
steps: Slice {onion} thinly and fry in {oil} until deep brown and crisp [t15]. Keep the oil.
Boil {lentils} until just tender [t15]; cook {pasta} separately.
Cook {rice} with the lentils and a spoon of the onion oil, covered on low [t18].
Simmer {passata} with {garlic}, {cumin}, {chilipowder} and {vinegar} [t10].
Layer rice and lentils, pasta and {chickpeas}; spoon over the sauce and top with the crispy onions.

recipe.name: Mujaddara with Cucumber Yogurt
steps: Slice {onion} and cook slowly in {oliveoil} until dark golden [t20]. Remove half for the topping.
Add {lentils}, {cumin} and 1 L water to the pot; simmer [t10].
Stir in {rice}, cover and cook on low until tender [t20].
Mix grated {cucumber*0.5} with {yogurt} and {mint}. Dice the rest with {tomato} for a salad.

recipe.name: Za'atar Manakish Breakfast Plate
steps: Mix {zaatar} with {oliveoil} into a loose paste.
Spread over {flatbread} and bake at 220 °C until the edges crisp [t6].
Serve with sliced {cucumber}, {tomato}, {yogurt} (or labneh) and {mint}.

recipe.name: Red Lentil Soup (Mercimek Çorbası)
steps: Soften chopped {onion} and {carrot} in {butter} [t5]. Stir in {tomatopaste} and {cumin}.
Add rinsed {lentils}, diced {potato} and {stock}. Simmer until everything is soft [t25].
Blend smooth. Finish with {paprika} sizzled in a little butter and a squeeze of {lemon}.

recipe.name: Kuku Sabzi (Herb Frittata)
steps: Very finely chop {parsley}, {cilantro}, {dill} and {scallion} — this is a herb cake bound by egg, not the other way round.
Beat {eggs} with {turmeric} and salt; fold in the herbs and chopped {walnuts}.
Pour into a hot pan with {oil}, cover and cook on low [t15]. Flip (or finish under the grill) until set in the centre [t5].
Cut into wedges and serve with {flatbread}.

recipe.name: Chicken Machboos
steps: Brown {chicken} in {oil}; remove. Soften {onion} and {garlic}, then add {baharat}, {cinnamon} and {cardamom}.
Add chopped {tomato}, a pierced whole {lime} and {stock}. Return the chicken and simmer [t30].
Lift out the chicken and roast at 220 °C to crisp the skin [t15].
Add rinsed {rice} to the broth; cover and cook on low [t20]. Serve the chicken over the rice.

recipe.name: Dal Tadka with Rice
steps: Rinse {lentils}; simmer with {turmeric} and 1 L water until soft [t25]. Cook {rice}.
Fry {cumin} in {oil} until it crackles. Add {onion}, {garlic} and {ginger}; cook until golden [t6].
Add {tomato} and {chilipowder}; cook until jammy, then pour over the dal.
Finish with {cilantro}.

recipe.name: Kanda Poha
steps: Rinse {poha} in a sieve under running water for 20 seconds; drain and rest.
Fry {peanuts} in {oil} until golden; remove. Add {mustardseed} until they pop.
Cook diced {potato} with {turmeric}, covered, until tender [t8]. Add {onion} and {greenchili} for 2 minutes.
Fold in the poha, peanuts and salt; steam covered 2 minutes. Finish with {lemon} and {cilantro}.

recipe.name: Palak Paneer with Roti
steps: Blanch {spinach} for 1 minute [t1], plunge into iced water and blend smooth.
Fry {cumin} in {oil}, add {onion}, {garlic} and {ginger}; cook until golden [t8]. Add {tomato} and cook down.
Stir in the spinach purée and {garammasala}; simmer 5 minutes.
Add cubed {paneer} and warm through. Serve with {flatbread}.

recipe.name: Masala Omelette with Paratha
steps: Finely chop {onion}, {tomato}, {greenchili} and {cilantro}; beat into {eggs} with salt.
Cook in batches in {oil} until just set [t3]; fold.
Serve with warm {flatbread}.

recipe.name: Chicken Karahi
steps: Sear {chicken} in {oil} over high heat [t6].
Add {garlic} and half the {ginger}; stir 1 minute. Add halved {tomato}, cover and cook until soft [t10]. Pull out the skins.
Cook uncovered, stirring, until the oil separates and the chicken is cooked through [t10].
Stir in {yogurt}, {garammasala}, sliced {greenchili} and the rest of the ginger in thin strips. Garnish with {cilantro}; serve with {flatbread}.

recipe.name: Coconut Dhal with Pol Sambol
steps: Simmer {lentils} with {turmeric}, half the onion and 600 ml water until soft [t15].
Stir in {coconutmilk}; simmer 5 minutes.
Fry {garlic} and the remaining {onion*0.5} in {oil}; pour over the dhal. Cook {rice}.
Pol sambol: rub {desiccated} with {chilipowder}, salt and the juice of {lime}.

recipe.name: Ginger Chicken Congee
steps: Simmer {rice} with {stock}, sliced {ginger} and whole {chicken}, partly covered [t20].
Lift out the chicken once cooked through; shred it.
Keep simmering, stirring now and then, until silky [t50].
Top with the chicken, {scallion}, {soysauce} and {sesameoil}.

recipe.name: Tomato & Egg Stir-fry with Rice
steps: Cook {rice}. Beat {eggs} with salt.
Scramble the eggs in half the {oil} until just set; remove.
Fry {tomato} wedges in the remaining oil with {sugar} and {soysauce} until saucy [t5].
Return the eggs, fold together and top with {scallion}.

recipes.title: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Rice & Bok Choy

recipe.name: Miso-Glazed Salmon with Rice & Bok Choy
steps: Cook {rice}. Mix {miso} and {mirin}; brush over {salmon}.
Grill or bake at 220 °C until glazed and the fish flakes [t10].
Steam halved {bokchoy} [t3]; dress with {soysauce}.
Sprinkle {sesameseeds} over everything.

recipe.name: Tamagoyaki & Miso Soup with Rice
steps: Cook {rice}.
Beat {eggs} with {sugar} and {soysauce}. Cook in thin layers in a pan wiped with {oil}, rolling each layer [t8].
Bring 1 L water to a bare simmer, whisk in {miso} (don't boil), add cubed {tofu} and {scallion}.

recipe.name: Bibimbap
steps: Cook {rice}.
Brown {beefmince} with {garlic} and {soysauce} until no pink remains [t6].
Blanch {spinach} and {beansprouts} separately [t1]; season each with a little {sesameoil}. Stir-fry thin strips of {carrot} [t2].
Fry {eggs} until the whites are set.
Arrange everything over the rice and serve with {gochujang}.

recipe.name: Green Curry with Chicken
steps: Cook {rice}. Fry {greencurrypaste} in {oil} with a few spoons of the thick top of the {coconutmilk} until fragrant [t3].
Add sliced {chicken}; cook 3 minutes, then the rest of the coconut milk.
Add {eggplant} and {greenbeans}; simmer until the chicken is cooked through [t12].
Season with {fishsauce} and {sugar}; tear in {basil}.

recipe.name: Lemongrass Pork Noodle Bowls
steps: Slice {pork} thin; marinate with minced {lemongrass}, {garlic}, half the {fishsauce} and half the {sugar} [t15].
Grill or pan-sear until caramelised and cooked through [t8].
Cook {ricenoodles} as the pack says, then rinse cold.
Mix the remaining fish sauce and sugar with the juice of {lime} and 120 ml water. Build bowls with noodles, {lettuce}, {cucumber}, {carrot}, {mint}, the pork and crushed {peanuts}.

recipe.name: Chicken Adobo
steps: Combine {chicken}, {soysauce}, smashed {garlic}, {bay} and {blackpepper}; rest 20 minutes [t20].
Brown the chicken in {oil}, add the marinade and {vinegar}. Don't stir until it boils — that mellows the vinegar.
Simmer covered until cooked through [t25], then uncovered to reduce to a glossy sauce [t10].
Serve with {rice}.

recipe.name: Nasi Goreng
steps: Use cold cooked rice: cook {rice} the day before, or cook it and spread it on a tray to cool [t20].
Stir-fry thin strips of {chicken} in {oil} until cooked through [t5]. Add {onion}, {garlic} and {chilipowder}.
Add the rice and {kecapmanis}; toss over high heat until hot [t4].
Fry {eggs} until set and serve on top with sliced {cucumber}.

recipe.name: Pasta e Ceci
steps: Soften {onion}, {garlic} and {rosemary} in {oliveoil} [t5].
Add {chickpeas}, {passata} and {stock}; simmer, then blend a third of it [t10].
Add {pasta} and cook in the soup until al dente, adding water if needed [t11].

recipe.name: Chicken Souvlaki Bowls with Tzatziki
steps: Marinate cubed {chicken} with the juice of {lemon}, {oregano}, half the {garlic} and {oliveoil} [t15].
Thread onto skewers and grill or pan-sear until cooked through [t12].
Tzatziki: grate half the {cucumber}, squeeze it dry and mix with {yogurt} and the remaining garlic.
Serve with {flatbread}, chopped {tomato}, the rest of the cucumber and {redonion}.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Honey, Walnuts & Berries

recipe.name: Greek Yogurt with Honey, Walnuts & Berries
steps: Spoon {yogurt} into bowls.
Top with {berries}, chopped {walnuts} and a drizzle of {honey}.

recipe.name: Tortilla Española
steps: Thinly slice {potato} and {onion}; poach gently in {oliveoil} until soft, not browned [t20]. Drain, keeping the oil.
Beat {eggs} with salt and fold in the potatoes; rest [t10].
Cook in a little of the oil over medium-low [t8], flip using a plate, and cook until set in the centre [t5].

recipe.name: Overnight Oats with Berries & Maple
steps: The night before, stir {oats}, {chia}, {milk} and {maple} together in jars. Chill overnight.
In the morning, top with {berries}.

recipe.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken, Sweet Potato & Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Toss cubed {sweetpotato} with half the {oliveoil}; roast [t15].
Add {chicken} rubbed with {paprika}, {garlic} and the rest of the oil; roast [t15].
Add {broccoli} florets and roast until charred at the edges and the chicken is cooked through [t12].

recipe.name: Jerk Chicken Jollof
steps: Rub {chicken} with {jerkpaste}; marinate [t20]. Roast at 220 °C until cooked through [t35].
Blend {tomato}, {redpepper}, {scotch} and half the {onion}.
Fry the rest of the onion and {tomatopaste} in {oil} until brick red, add the blend, {thyme} and {allspice}; reduce by half [t20].
Add rinsed {rice} and {stock}; cover tightly and steam on low [t30]. Serve under the jerk chicken.

recipe.name: Plantain & Pepper Shakshuka
steps: Fry diced ripe {plantain} in half the {oil} until caramelised; set aside.
Soften {onion}, {redpepper} and {scotch} in the remaining oil with {cumin} [t6]. Add {passata}; simmer [t8].
Stir in the plantain, make wells and crack in {eggs}; cover until the whites are set [t7].

recipe.name: Suya Beef Bowls with Pikliz
steps: Quick pikliz: shred {cabbage} and {carrot}, add sliced {scotch}, cover with {vinegar} and salt [t15].
Suya spice: grind {peanuts} with {chilipowder}, grated {ginger} and salt. Coat thin strips of {sirloin}.
Sear in a very hot pan until charred [t5]. Cook {rice}.
Serve the beef over rice with sliced {onion}, {tomato} and the pikliz.

recipe.name: Curry Chickpeas with Plantain & Greens
steps: Toast {curry} in {oil} for 1 minute, then soften {onion}, {garlic} and {scotch} [t5].
Add drained {chickpeas} and {coconutmilk}; simmer [t12]. Cook {rice}.
Fold in sliced {kale} and cook until tender [t4].
Fry sliced ripe {plantain} until golden and serve alongside.

recipe.name: Nigerian Rice & Beans
steps: Pick through {honeybeans} for stones, rinse, and boil in plenty of water until just tender but holding shape [t40]. Don't salt yet: salt toughens the skins.
Rinse {parboiledrice} until the water runs clear. Add it to the beans with {stock} and enough hot water to cover by 2 cm. Cover and cook on low until the rice is soft and the water is absorbed [t25].
Warm {palmoil} gently (no smoke), fry sliced {onion} and pounded {scotch} until soft and fragrant [t5], then stir in {crayfish}.
Fold the palm-oil sauce through the rice and beans and season with salt. The grains should be separate, the beans creamy inside.

recipe.name: Dodo (Fried Ripe Plantain)
steps: Use plantains with mostly black skins: they're sweetest. Peel {plantain} and cut on the diagonal into 1 cm slices; salt lightly.
Heat {oil} in a deep pan to about 175 °C: a slice should sizzle at once.
Fry in batches without crowding until deep golden with caramelised edges, turning once [t4].
Drain on paper. Dodo is done when the edges are dark amber and the centre is soft and sweet.

recipe.name: Jamaican Rice & Peas
steps: Pour {kidneybeans} with their liquid and {coconutmilk} into a pot. Add crushed {garlic}, {thyme}, {allspice} and bruised {scallion}; top up with water to make about 900 ml liquid.
Bring to a simmer, add a whole {scotch} (don't burst it: it perfumes rather than burns) and season well with salt.
Stir in rinsed {rice}, cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat [t25] until the liquid is absorbed.
Lift out the scotch bonnet and scallion. Fluff with a fork: the rice should be pale pink and fragrant with coconut.

recipe.name: Jamaican Fried Ripe Plantain
steps: Peel ripe {plantain} (yellow with plenty of black spots) and slice lengthwise or on a long diagonal, about 1 cm thick.
Shallow-fry in {oil} over medium heat, turning once, until both sides are golden brown and glossy [t6].
Drain briefly. Serve warm beside jerk, ackee or rice and peas.

recipe.name: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
steps: Blend {scallion}, {scotch}, {allspice}, {thyme}, {garlic}, {ginger}, the juice of {lime}, {soysauce}, {sugar} and {oil} into a thick marinade.
Slash {chicken} to the bone, rub the marinade into every cut and marinate at least 2 hours, ideally overnight [t120].
Roast at 200 °C, or grill over medium coals, turning, until charred at the edges and cooked through [t45].
Rest 5 minutes. Jerk is ready when the skin is blistered and dark in places and the juices run clear.

recipe.name: Pazham Pori (Kerala Plantain Fritters)
steps: Whisk {flour}, {sugar}, {turmeric} and a pinch of salt with about 180 ml water into a smooth batter that coats a spoon.
Peel ripe {plantain} (Kerala nendran if you can find it) and slice lengthwise into thin, long strips.
Heat {oil} to about 175 °C. Dip each strip in batter and fry until puffed and golden on both sides [t4].
Drain and serve hot with tea, the way it's eaten at Kerala tea shops in the evening.

recipe_steps.instruction: Season 1 kg chicken thighs with 1 tsp curry powder, ½ tsp dried thyme and salt. Roast at 220 °C until golden and cooked through (35 min).
Blend 4 tomatoes (500 g), 1 red pepper (200 g), 1 scotch bonnet and 1 onion until smooth.
Slice the remaining 1 onion. Heat 5½ tbsp vegetable oil in a heavy pot, fry the onion 3 minutes, then add 70 g tomato paste and fry until it darkens to brick red (5 min).
Pour in the blend with the rest of the curry and thyme and ¾ tsp bay leaves. Cook uncovered, stirring often, until reduced by half and the oil rises to the top (20 min).

Rinse 500 g long-grain rice until the water runs clear. Stir it into the base with 700 ml vegetable stock. Cover with foil and a lid and cook on the lowest heat (30 min). Shake the pot instead of stirring.
Done when the grains are tender but separate. Let a light crust form at the bottom for smoky party flavour, then serve with the chicken.
Cut 600 g stewing beef into chunks, season with salt and half the onion, and simmer in 300 ml vegetable stock until tender (30 min). Keep the broth.
Peel 1 kg puna yam, cut into thick rounds and boil in salted water until a knife slides in easily (20 min).
Blend 1 red pepper (200 g) and 1 scotch bonnet coarsely. Wash and roughly chop 600 g spinach, then squeeze out the water.
Warm 4 tbsp red palm oil gently (don't let it smoke). Fry the remaining ½ onion, add the pepper blend and fry until thick (10 min).
Add the beef, a splash of broth and 15 g ground dried crayfish. Fold in the spinach and cook just until wilted and bright green (3 min). Serve with the yam.
Soak 400 g black-eyed peas for 15 minutes, then rub between your palms to slip off the skins; rinse until mostly skinless (15 min).
Hard-boil 3 eggs (10 min), cool and halve.
Blend the beans with 1 red pepper, ½ onion and 250 ml vegetable stock into a smooth, thick batter.
Stir in 4 tbsp vegetable oil, 10 g ground dried crayfish and salt. Divide into greased ramekins or foil packets and tuck half an egg into each.
Steam over simmering water, topping up as needed (45 min). Set when a knife comes out clean.
Soak 300 g black-eyed peas 15 minutes and rub off the skins (15 min).
Blend with ½ onion and ½ scotch bonnet using as little water as possible. Whisk the batter for 3 minutes until fluffy — this is what makes akara light.
Heat 400 ml vegetable oil to 175 °C. Drop in spoonfuls of batter and fry, turning, until deep golden (6 min).
Drain on paper and serve hot, tucked into 400 g soft white loaf.
Peel and cube 800 g puna yam; boil in salted water until fork-tender (15 min).
Meanwhile dice 2 tomatoes (300 g), ½ onion and ½ scotch bonnet. Fry the onion in 2½ tbsp vegetable oil for 2 minutes, add tomato and scotch and cook down (6 min).
Pour in beaten 6 eggs and stir gently until fully set, with no runny parts. Serve over the yam.
Cut 1 kg chicken thighs into pieces. Put in a pot with chopped 1 onion, 2 tbsp pepper soup spice, salt and 1.5 L vegetable stock.
Bring to a boil, then simmer (25 min).
Add cubed 3 potatoes (600 g) and pounded 1 scotch bonnet; simmer until the potatoes are tender and the chicken is cooked through (15 min).
Tear in 20 g basil / scent leaf (stands in for scent leaf) and serve steaming.
Simmer 600 g stewing beef in 800 ml vegetable stock with half the onion and salt until tender (30 min).
Blend the remaining ½ onion and mix with 250 g ground egusi and a little water into a thick paste.
Warm 5½ tbsp red palm oil, add the egusi paste in spoonfuls and fry undisturbed for 5 minutes, then stir and fry until curdled and nutty (10 min).
Add the beef and broth, 1 scotch bonnet and 20 g ground dried crayfish. Simmer (10 min). Fold in chopped 400 g spinach and cook 3 minutes.
Eba: pour 400 g garri into about 2½ times its volume of just-boiled water, rest 2 minutes, then stir hard into a smooth, firm dough.
Simmer 500 g black-eyed peas in plenty of water until soft but holding shape (40 min). Drain.
Fry chopped 1½ onion (200 g) in 4 tbsp red palm oil, add grated 20 g fresh ginger, chopped 3 tomatoes (400 g) and ½ scotch bonnet; cook to a thick sauce (10 min).
Stir in the beans and simmer 5 minutes until everything turns red red.
Slice ripe 4 plantains (1 kg) on the diagonal and fry in 100 ml vegetable oil until caramelised on both sides (6 min).
Marinate 1 kg chicken thighs with the juice of 4 lemons (400 g), 30 g dijon mustard, minced 4 garlic cloves, half the oil and sliced 6 onions (900 g) for at least 30 minutes (30 min).
Lift out the chicken and sear in the remaining 2 tbsp vegetable oil until browned. Set aside.
Cook the onions from the marinade slowly until soft and golden (20 min), then return the chicken with the marinade and a whole ½ scotch bonnet.
Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through (25 min). Meanwhile cook 400 g long-grain rice.
Season 1 kg chicken thighs with 2 garlic cloves, 15 g fresh ginger and salt; brown in half the 120 ml vegetable oil (10 min).
Fry sliced ripe 4 plantains (1 kg) in the rest of the oil until golden; set aside.
Add 1½ onion (200 g), 1½ tomato (200 g), sliced 200 g carrots, 200 g green beans and 1 red pepper (200 g) to the chicken with 200 ml water; simmer until the chicken is cooked through (20 min).
Fold in the plantains and warm through.
Cook finely chopped 3 onions (400 g) in a dry pot, stirring, until soft and jammy (10 min), then add 4 tbsp vegetable oil.
Add 25 g berbere, 3 garlic cloves, 15 g fresh ginger and 30 g tomato paste; cook 3 minutes.
Add 400 g red lentils and 1 L water; simmer, stirring, until thick and soft (25 min).
Serve with injera, or 400 g flatbread / roti / pita if injera isn't available.
Brown 400 g lean ground beef in 2 tbsp vegetable oil until no pink remains (6 min).
Add 1 onion and 2 tomatoes (300 g); cook down (5 min). Add finely sliced 600 g kale / callaloo greens and cook just until tender (5 min).
Ugali: bring 1.2 L water to a boil, gradually add 500 g fine cornmeal / maize flour and stir hard with a wooden spoon until thick and pulling from the sides (10 min).
Grill or pan-fry 600 g beef sausage until browned and cooked through (15 min).

Chakalaka: fry 1 onion, 1 red pepper (200 g), 2 garlic cloves, ½ scotch bonnet and 1.5 tbsp curry powder in 2 tbsp vegetable oil; add grated 300 g carrots (8 min), then 400 g baked beans; simmer 5 minutes.
Pap: whisk 400 g fine cornmeal / maize flour into 1.2 L boiling water, cover and cook on low, stirring now and then (20 min).
Soak 250 g salted cod overnight, or boil it in fresh water twice for 10 minutes each to remove the salt (20 min). Flake, discarding bones.
Fry sliced 1 onion, 1 red pepper and ½ scotch bonnet in half the 2½ tbsp vegetable oil with ¾ tsp dried thyme until soft (5 min).
Add the saltfish and chopped 1½ tomato (200 g); cook 3 minutes.
Drain 540 g ackee and fold in very gently so it stays in pieces. Heat through (3 min).
Fry sliced 2 plantains (500 g) in the remaining oil until golden.
Rub 1.2 kg chicken thighs with half the 30 g curry powder, minced 3 garlic cloves, 1¼ tsp dried thyme, 1¼ tsp ground allspice and salt. Rest 20 minutes, or overnight (20 min).
Toast the remaining curry in hot 2½ tbsp vegetable oil for 1 minute until fragrant, then brown the chicken.
Add sliced 1½ onion (200 g), a whole ½ scotch bonnet and 500 ml water. Cover and simmer (30 min).
Add cubed 3 potatoes (500 g) and simmer uncovered until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through (15 min). Serve with 400 g long-grain rice.
Rub 1 kg chicken thighs with 80 g jerk seasoning paste; marinate at least 30 minutes (overnight is best) (30 min).
Roast at 220 °C until charred at the edges and cooked through (35 min).

Rice and peas: bring 400 ml coconut milk, the liquid from 400 g red kidney beans topped up with water to 1 L, 1¼ tsp dried thyme, 1¼ tsp ground allspice, crushed 60 g green onions and a whole ½ scotch bonnet to a simmer.
Add rinsed 500 g long-grain rice and the beans, cover and cook on low until fluffy (25 min). Remove the scotch bonnet before serving.
Whisk 200 g fine cornmeal / maize flour into 500 ml cold water until no lumps remain.
Bring 600 ml milk and 400 ml coconut milk to a simmer, then whisk in the cornmeal mixture.
Cook on low, stirring often, until thick and smooth (12 min).
Sweeten with 60 g sugar and finish with ¾ tsp ground nutmeg and ¾ tsp ground cinnamon.
Mix 300 g all-purpose flour with a pinch of salt and about 150 ml water into a firm dough. Shape into small flat rounds.
Fry the dumplings in 150 ml vegetable oil over medium heat until golden and hollow-sounding (10 min).
Strip and slice 400 g kale / callaloo greens (stands in for callaloo). Melt 30 g butter, soften ½ onion, 2 garlic cloves and ½ scotch bonnet, then add 1 tomato.
Add the greens with a splash of water, cover and steam until tender (8 min).
Mix 20 g curry powder and 2 tsp cumin with a little water into a paste. Fry in 2½ tbsp vegetable oil until it darkens (2 min).
Add chopped 1 onion and 3 garlic cloves, then cubed 3 potatoes (500 g), drained 800 g chickpeas, ½ scotch bonnet and 500 ml water.
Simmer until the potatoes break down and thicken the sauce (20 min). Mash a few chickpeas against the pot.
Stir in 20 g cilantro (stands in for shado beni) and serve with warm 400 g flatbread / roti / pita.
Pikliz: shred 300 g green cabbage and 150 g carrots, slice ½ scotch bonnet, pack into a jar and cover with 250 ml white vinegar and a pinch of salt. Chill.
Cube 1 kg pork shoulder and marinate with the juice of 1½ orange (300 g) and 2 limes, 4 garlic cloves, 1 onion, 1¼ tsp dried thyme and the remaining scotch (30 min).
Simmer the pork in its marinade plus water to cover until tender (50 min). Drain.
Fry the pork in 4 tbsp vegetable oil until crisp at the edges (10 min). Serve with 400 g long-grain rice and pikliz.
Slice 1½ red onion (200 g) thinly and soak in 2½ tbsp white vinegar with a pinch of salt.
Peel 4 green plantains (1 kg), cut into chunks and boil until very soft (20 min).
Mash with 40 g butter and a splash of the cooking water until smooth.
Fry 4 eggs in 1½ tbsp vegetable oil until the whites are fully set. Top the mangú with eggs and pickled onions.
Sofrito: cook chopped 1 onion, 1 red pepper and 3 garlic cloves in 2½ tbsp olive oil until soft (8 min).
Add 1½ tsp cumin, ¾ tsp dried oregano and ¾ tsp bay leaves, then 400 g long-grain rice; stir 1 minute to toast.
Add 800 g black beans with their liquid and 600 ml vegetable stock. Cover and simmer on low (20 min).
Rest 5 minutes off the heat, then fluff.
Char 3 tomatoes (400 g), ½ onion and 1 jalapeño in a dry pan (6 min), then blend into a salsa and simmer 5 minutes.
Warm 400 g black beans and mash lightly.
Warm 300 g corn tortillas in a dry pan. Fry 8 eggs in 2 tbsp vegetable oil until the whites are set.
Layer tortillas, beans, egg and salsa. Top with sliced 2 avocados (300 g), crumbled 100 g queso fresco / feta and 20 g cilantro.
Poach 800 g chicken thighs in salted water until cooked through (20 min). Shred.
Blend 3 tomatoes (400 g), 40 g chipotles in adobo and 2 garlic cloves. Soften sliced 1½ onion (200 g) in 1½ tbsp vegetable oil, add the sauce and simmer (8 min).
Fold in the chicken and simmer until saucy.
Serve in warm 400 g corn tortillas with shredded 200 g green cabbage, 1 avocado and wedges of 2 limes.
Cook 400 g long-grain rice. Cut 4 potatoes (700 g) into fries and oven-bake at 220 °C until crisp (30 min).
Slice 700 g beef sirloin into strips. Sear in very hot 2 tbsp vegetable oil in batches until browned (3 min). Remove.
Stir-fry wedges of 2 red onions (300 g) and ½ jalapeño for 1 minute, add 2 tomatoes (300 g) wedges, 3 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp white vinegar.
Return the beef, toss with the fries and 20 g cilantro. Serve with rice.
Marinate 800 g white fish fillets with the juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves and salt (15 min).
Layer sliced 1½ onion (200 g), 1 red pepper (200 g) and 2 tomatoes (300 g) in a wide pot and lay the fish on top.
Pour over 400 ml coconut milk and 2 tbsp red palm oil. Cover and simmer gently until the fish flakes (15 min).
Scatter with 20 g cilantro. Serve with 400 g long-grain rice.
Mix 300 g masarepa with 400 ml warm water and salt into a soft dough. Rest (5 min).
Shape 8 patties and cook in a dry pan until crusty on both sides (12 min).
Melt 30 g butter, cook chopped 60 g green onions and 1½ tomato (200 g) for 3 minutes.
Add beaten 8 eggs and scramble until fully set. Split the arepas and fill with eggs and 100 g queso fresco / feta.
Soften chopped 1½ onion (200 g) and 3 garlic cloves in 2½ tbsp olive oil (5 min). Add 2 tbsp ras el hanout and cook 1 minute.
Add chunks of 300 g carrots and 1½ sweet potato (500 g), 400 ml crushed tomatoes / passata and 400 ml water. Simmer (15 min).
Add 1 zucchini (300 g), drained 800 g chickpeas and 100 g dried apricots. Simmer until all the vegetables are tender (15 min).
Pour 1¼ times its volume of boiling water over 400 g couscous, cover 5 minutes, then fluff. Serve with 20 g cilantro.
Soften sliced 1 onion and 1½ red pepper (300 g) in 2 tbsp olive oil (8 min). Add 2 garlic cloves, 1½ tsp cumin and 1½ tsp smoked paprika.
Pour in 700 ml crushed tomatoes / passata and simmer until thick (10 min).
Make 8 wells and crack in 8 eggs. Cover and cook until the whites are fully set (7 min).
Scatter with 20 g flat-leaf parsley and serve with 400 g soft white loaf.
Slice 3 onions (400 g) thinly and fry in 5½ tbsp vegetable oil until deep brown and crisp (15 min). Keep the oil.
Boil 250 g red lentils until just tender (15 min); cook 250 g short pasta separately.
Cook 300 g long-grain rice with the lentils and a spoon of the onion oil, covered on low (18 min).
Simmer 500 ml crushed tomatoes / passata with 3 garlic cloves, 1½ tsp cumin, ¾ tsp chilli powder / cayenne and 2 tbsp white vinegar (10 min).
Layer rice and lentils, pasta and 400 g chickpeas; spoon over the sauce and top with the crispy onions.
Slice 4 onions (600 g) and cook slowly in 5½ tbsp olive oil until dark golden (20 min). Remove half for the topping.
Add 300 g red lentils, 1½ tsp cumin and 1 L water to the pot; simmer (10 min).
Stir in 250 g long-grain rice, cover and cook on low until tender (20 min).
Mix grated ½ cucumber with 300 g plain yogurt and 10 g mint. Dice the rest with 2 tomatoes (300 g) for a salad.
Mix 40 g za'atar with 4 tbsp olive oil into a loose paste.
Spread over 400 g flatbread / roti / pita and bake at 220 °C until the edges crisp (6 min).
Serve with sliced 1 cucumber (300 g), 2 tomatoes (250 g), 250 g plain yogurt (or labneh) and 10 g mint.
Soften chopped 1 onion and 150 g carrots in 30 g butter (5 min). Stir in 30 g tomato paste and 1½ tsp cumin.
Add rinsed 300 g red lentils, diced 1 potato and 1.5 L vegetable stock. Simmer until everything is soft (25 min).
Blend smooth. Finish with 1¼ tsp smoked paprika sizzled in a little butter and a squeeze of 1 lemon.
Very finely chop 120 g flat-leaf parsley, 120 g cilantro, 30 g dill and 100 g green onions — this is a herb cake bound by egg, not the other way round.
Beat 8 eggs with ¾ tsp turmeric and salt; fold in the herbs and chopped 50 g walnuts.
Pour into a hot pan with 2½ tbsp vegetable oil, cover and cook on low (15 min). Flip (or finish under the grill) until set in the centre (5 min).
Cut into wedges and serve with 400 g flatbread / roti / pita.
Brown 1 kg chicken thighs in 2½ tbsp vegetable oil; remove. Soften 1½ onion (200 g) and 3 garlic cloves, then add 1.5 tbsp baharat, ¾ tsp ground cinnamon and ¾ tsp ground cardamom.
Add chopped 1½ tomato (200 g), a pierced whole 1 lime and 1 L vegetable stock. Return the chicken and simmer (30 min).
Lift out the chicken and roast at 220 °C to crisp the skin (15 min).
Add rinsed 500 g long-grain rice to the broth; cover and cook on low (20 min). Serve the chicken over the rice.
Rinse 350 g red lentils; simmer with ¾ tsp turmeric and 1 L water until soft (25 min). Cook 400 g long-grain rice.
Fry 1½ tsp cumin in 2½ tbsp vegetable oil until it crackles. Add 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 15 g fresh ginger; cook until golden (6 min).
Add 1½ tomato (200 g) and ¾ tsp chilli powder / cayenne; cook until jammy, then pour over the dal.
Finish with 20 g cilantro.
Rinse 300 g poha in a sieve under running water for 20 seconds; drain and rest.
Fry 60 g roasted peanuts in 2 tbsp vegetable oil until golden; remove. Add 1½ tsp black mustard seeds until they pop.
Cook diced 1 potato (200 g) with ¾ tsp turmeric, covered, until tender (8 min). Add 1 onion and 10 g green chillies for 2 minutes.
Fold in the poha, peanuts and salt; steam covered 2 minutes. Finish with ½ lemon and 20 g cilantro.
Blanch 600 g spinach for 1 minute (1 min), plunge into iced water and blend smooth.
Fry 1¼ tsp cumin in 2½ tbsp vegetable oil, add 1 onion, 3 garlic cloves and 15 g fresh ginger; cook until golden (8 min). Add 1 tomato and cook down.
Stir in the spinach purée and 2 tsp garam masala; simmer 5 minutes.
Add cubed 400 g paneer and warm through. Serve with 400 g flatbread / roti / pita.
Finely chop ½ onion, 1 tomato, 10 g green chillies and 20 g cilantro; beat into 8 eggs with salt.
Cook in batches in 1½ tbsp vegetable oil until just set (3 min); fold.
Serve with warm 400 g flatbread / roti / pita.
Sear 1 kg chicken thighs in 4 tbsp vegetable oil over high heat (6 min).
Add 4 garlic cloves and half the 40 g fresh ginger; stir 1 minute. Add halved 5 tomatoes (600 g), cover and cook until soft (10 min). Pull out the skins.
Cook uncovered, stirring, until the oil separates and the chicken is cooked through (10 min).
Stir in 150 g plain yogurt, 2 tsp garam masala, sliced 20 g green chillies and the rest of the ginger in thin strips. Garnish with 20 g cilantro; serve with 400 g flatbread / roti / pita.
Simmer 300 g red lentils with ¾ tsp turmeric, half the onion and 600 ml water until soft (15 min).
Stir in 400 ml coconut milk; simmer 5 minutes.
Fry 2 garlic cloves and the remaining ½ onion in 1½ tbsp vegetable oil; pour over the dhal. Cook 300 g long-grain rice.
Pol sambol: rub 100 g desiccated coconut with 1¼ tsp chilli powder / cayenne, salt and the juice of 1 lime.
Simmer 250 g long-grain rice with 2 L vegetable stock, sliced 40 g fresh ginger and whole 400 g chicken thighs, partly covered (20 min).
Lift out the chicken once cooked through; shred it.
Keep simmering, stirring now and then, until silky (50 min).
Top with the chicken, 60 g green onions, 2 tbsp soy sauce and ½ tbsp toasted sesame oil.
Cook 400 g long-grain rice. Beat 8 eggs with salt.
Scramble the eggs in half the 2½ tbsp vegetable oil until just set; remove.
Fry 6 tomatoes (800 g) wedges in the remaining oil with 10 g sugar and 1 tbsp soy sauce until saucy (5 min).
Return the eggs, fold together and top with 60 g green onions.
Cook 400 g long-grain rice. Mix 60 g white miso and 2 tbsp mirin; brush over 600 g salmon fillets.
Grill or bake at 220 °C until glazed and the fish flakes (10 min).
Steam halved 400 g bok choy (3 min); dress with 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Sprinkle 10 g sesame seeds over everything.
Cook 300 g long-grain rice.
Beat 8 eggs with 10 g sugar and ½ tbsp soy sauce. Cook in thin layers in a pan wiped with ½ tbsp vegetable oil, rolling each layer (8 min).
Bring 1 L water to a bare simmer, whisk in 50 g white miso (don't boil), add cubed 300 g firm tofu and 40 g green onions.
Cook 400 g long-grain rice.
Brown 400 g lean ground beef with 2 garlic cloves and 2 tbsp soy sauce until no pink remains (6 min).
Blanch 300 g spinach and 200 g bean sprouts separately (1 min); season each with a little 1½ tbsp toasted sesame oil. Stir-fry thin strips of 200 g carrots (2 min).
Fry 4 eggs until the whites are set.
Arrange everything over the rice and serve with 60 g gochujang.
Cook 400 g long-grain rice. Fry 60 g thai green curry paste in 1 tbsp vegetable oil with a few spoons of the thick top of the 800 ml coconut milk until fragrant (3 min).
Add sliced 700 g chicken thighs; cook 3 minutes, then the rest of the coconut milk.
Add 1 eggplant (300 g) and 200 g green beans; simmer until the chicken is cooked through (12 min).
Season with 2 tbsp fish sauce and 10 g sugar; tear in 20 g basil / scent leaf.
Slice 600 g pork shoulder thin; marinate with minced 40 g lemongrass, 2 garlic cloves, half the 2½ tbsp fish sauce and half the 30 g sugar (15 min).
Grill or pan-sear until caramelised and cooked through (8 min).
Cook 400 g rice vermicelli as the pack says, then rinse cold.

Mix the remaining fish sauce and sugar with the juice of 1 lime and 120 ml water. Build bowls with noodles, 200 g lettuce, ½ cucumber (200 g), 150 g carrots, 20 g mint, the pork and crushed 60 g roasted peanuts.
Combine 1.2 kg chicken thighs, 120 ml soy sauce, smashed 8 garlic cloves, 1¼ tsp bay leaves and 1½ tsp whole black peppercorns; rest 20 minutes (20 min).
Brown the chicken in 1½ tbsp vegetable oil, add the marinade and 120 ml white vinegar. Don't stir until it boils — that mellows the vinegar.
Simmer covered until cooked through (25 min), then uncovered to reduce to a glossy sauce (10 min).
Serve with 500 g long-grain rice.
Use cold cooked rice: cook 350 g long-grain rice the day before, or cook it and spread it on a tray to cool (20 min).
Stir-fry thin strips of 300 g chicken thighs in 2½ tbsp vegetable oil until cooked through (5 min). Add 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves and 1¼ tsp chilli powder / cayenne.
Add the rice and 3 tbsp kecap manis; toss over high heat until hot (4 min).
Fry 4 eggs until set and serve on top with sliced ½ cucumber (200 g).
Soften ½ onion, 2 garlic cloves and ¾ tsp dried rosemary in 2½ tbsp olive oil (5 min).
Add 800 g chickpeas, 300 ml crushed tomatoes / passata and 1 L vegetable stock; simmer, then blend a third of it (10 min).
Add 350 g short pasta and cook in the soup until al dente, adding water if needed (11 min).
Marinate cubed 800 g chicken thighs with the juice of 1 lemon, 1¼ tsp dried oregano, half the 3 garlic cloves and 2½ tbsp olive oil (15 min).
Thread onto skewers and grill or pan-sear until cooked through (12 min).
Tzatziki: grate half the 1 cucumber (300 g), squeeze it dry and mix with 300 g plain yogurt and the remaining garlic.
Serve with 400 g flatbread / roti / pita, chopped 2 tomatoes (300 g), the rest of the cucumber and ½ red onion.
Spoon 800 g plain yogurt into bowls.
Top with 340 g mixed berries, chopped 80 g walnuts and a drizzle of 60 g honey.
Thinly slice 4 potatoes (800 g) and 1½ onion (200 g); poach gently in 200 ml olive oil until soft, not browned (20 min). Drain, keeping the oil.
Beat 8 eggs with salt and fold in the potatoes; rest (10 min).
Cook in a little of the oil over medium-low (8 min), flip using a plate, and cook until set in the centre (5 min).
The night before, stir 320 g rolled oats, 40 g chia seeds, 800 ml milk and 2½ tbsp maple syrup together in jars. Chill overnight.
In the morning, top with 340 g mixed berries.
Heat the oven to 220 °C. Toss cubed 2 sweet potatoes (800 g) with half the 2½ tbsp olive oil; roast (15 min).
Add 800 g chicken thighs rubbed with 1½ tsp smoked paprika, 2 garlic cloves and the rest of the oil; roast (15 min).
Add 500 g broccoli florets and roast until charred at the edges and the chicken is cooked through (12 min).
Rub 1 kg chicken thighs with 60 g jerk seasoning paste; marinate (20 min). Roast at 220 °C until cooked through (35 min).
Blend 3 tomatoes (400 g), 1 red pepper (200 g), ½ scotch bonnet and half the 1½ onion (200 g).
Fry the rest of the onion and 50 g tomato paste in 4 tbsp vegetable oil until brick red, add the blend, 1¼ tsp dried thyme and ¾ tsp ground allspice; reduce by half (20 min).
Add rinsed 500 g long-grain rice and 700 ml vegetable stock; cover tightly and steam on low (30 min). Serve under the jerk chicken.
Fry diced ripe 2 plantains (500 g) in half the 2½ tbsp vegetable oil until caramelised; set aside.
Soften ½ onion, 1 red pepper (200 g) and ½ scotch bonnet in the remaining oil with 1¼ tsp cumin (6 min). Add 500 ml crushed tomatoes / passata; simmer (8 min).
Stir in the plantain, make wells and crack in 8 eggs; cover until the whites are set (7 min).
Quick pikliz: shred 300 g green cabbage and 150 g carrots, add sliced ½ scotch bonnet, cover with 200 ml white vinegar and salt (15 min).
Suya spice: grind 60 g roasted peanuts with 2 tsp chilli powder / cayenne, grated 10 g fresh ginger and salt. Coat thin strips of 700 g beef sirloin.
Sear in a very hot pan until charred (5 min). Cook 400 g long-grain rice.
Serve the beef over rice with sliced ½ onion, 1½ tomato (200 g) and the pikliz.
Toast 2 tbsp curry powder in 2½ tbsp vegetable oil for 1 minute, then soften 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves and ½ scotch bonnet (5 min).
Add drained 800 g chickpeas and 400 ml coconut milk; simmer (12 min). Cook 400 g long-grain rice.
Fold in sliced 250 g kale / callaloo greens and cook until tender (4 min).
Fry sliced ripe 2 plantains (500 g) until golden and serve alongside.
Pick through 300 g honey beans for stones, rinse, and boil in plenty of water until just tender but holding shape (40 min). Don't salt yet: salt toughens the skins.

Rinse 400 g parboiled long-grain rice until the water runs clear. Add it to the beans with 300 ml vegetable stock and enough hot water to cover by 2 cm. Cover and cook on low until the rice is soft and the water is absorbed (25 min).
Warm 4 tbsp red palm oil gently (no smoke), fry sliced 1 onion and pounded ½ scotch bonnet until soft and fragrant (5 min), then stir in 10 g ground dried crayfish.
Fold the palm-oil sauce through the rice and beans and season with salt. The grains should be separate, the beans creamy inside.
Use plantains with mostly black skins: they're sweetest. Peel 4 plantains (1 kg) and cut on the diagonal into 1 cm slices; salt lightly.
Heat 400 ml vegetable oil in a deep pan to about 175 °C: a slice should sizzle at once.
Fry in batches without crowding until deep golden with caramelised edges, turning once (4 min).
Drain on paper. Dodo is done when the edges are dark amber and the centre is soft and sweet.

Pour 400 g red kidney beans with their liquid and 400 ml coconut milk into a pot. Add crushed 2 garlic cloves, 1¼ tsp dried thyme, 1¼ tsp ground allspice and bruised 60 g green onions; top up with water to make about 900 ml liquid.
Bring to a simmer, add a whole 1 scotch bonnet (don't burst it: it perfumes rather than burns) and season well with salt.
Stir in rinsed 400 g long-grain rice, cover tightly and cook on the lowest heat (25 min) until the liquid is absorbed.
Lift out the scotch bonnet and scallion. Fluff with a fork: the rice should be pale pink and fragrant with coconut.
Peel ripe 3 plantains (750 g) (yellow with plenty of black spots) and slice lengthwise or on a long diagonal, about 1 cm thick.
Shallow-fry in 150 ml vegetable oil over medium heat, turning once, until both sides are golden brown and glossy (6 min).
Drain briefly. Serve warm beside jerk, ackee or rice and peas.

Blend 100 g green onions, 1½ scotch bonnet, 2½ tsp ground allspice, 1¼ tsp dried thyme, 4 garlic cloves, 20 g fresh ginger, the juice of 1 lime, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 20 g sugar and 2 tbsp vegetable oil into a thick marinade.
Slash 1.2 kg chicken thighs to the bone, rub the marinade into every cut and marinate at least 2 hours, ideally overnight (120 min).
Roast at 200 °C, or grill over medium coals, turning, until charred at the edges and cooked through (45 min).
Rest 5 minutes. Jerk is ready when the skin is blistered and dark in places and the juices run clear.
Whisk 150 g all-purpose flour, 30 g sugar, ½ tsp turmeric and a pinch of salt with about 180 ml water into a smooth batter that coats a spoon.
Peel ripe 3 plantains (750 g) (Kerala nendran if you can find it) and slice lengthwise into thin, long strips.
Heat 500 ml vegetable oil to about 175 °C. Dip each strip in batter and fry until puffed and golden on both sides (4 min).
Drain and serve hot with tea, the way it's eaten at Kerala tea shops in the evening.
